text:
maria: Quick kickoff — we need to lock the roadmap slice for the Optimize guidance effort (batching/caching/quant + eval-triggered alerts). Customer asks piled up; want a proposed minimal launch that actually reduces unit cost while keeping quality safe.

sam: +1. Can we split into Core + Signals phases? Core = batching + prefix/KV cache suggestions + quant profiles. Signals = eval-triggered alerts, regression hooks, alerting thresholds.

jordan: Agree on phases. For Core, recommend two surfaces: 1) automated config suggestion (per-route profiles) and 2) per-deployment quick checklist (what to enable safely).

lee: Customer constraint: Acme & Stripe asked for quant recommendations but need a fallback to float model on regressions. So launch gate must include a fallback policy.

manual note from ops-bot: deploy queue length 3, ETA for engineering review 2d.

anita: Launch criteria proposal:
- measurable econ delta: >=15% token-cost reduction on targeted workloads
- quality guardrail: eval concordance >= baseline - 2% on critical prompts
- recovery: auto-fallback within 30s of detected regression
- SLO: p99 latency regression <= +10%

sam: Those look reasonable. For quant profiles, do we ship recommended quant levels + a small test harness to run on customer's sample prompts? That helps satisfy the concordance gate.

maria: Yes — MVP includes a lightweight harness (runs n=200 prompts) and returns delta metrics. Add it to docs + SDK call.

jordan: For batching: we should provide both a conservative and aggressive recommendation based on traffic shape. Example config snippet in docs: \n```\nbatch_policy: {\n  target_latency_ms: 50,\n  max_batch_tokens: 4096,\n  latency_tail_safety: 0.95\n}\n```\nConservative = lower max_batch_tokens, Aggressive = larger, with explicit SLI tradeoffs.

lee: Who owns the per-route telemetry to drive these suggestions? We need token histograms + seq len distribution. Is that in Console telemetry now?

anita: Console has seq-length histograms but not per-route KV hit rates. We'll need a short telemetry ticket to add KV/prefix cache hit counters. MVP can estimate from prefix reuse heuristics.

sam: Prioritization ask: if we can only do one telemetry piece pre-MVP, make it seq-length distribution + request rate bins. That unlocks batching recs for 80% of customers.

maria: Customer-driven asks we keep: 1) self-serve quant recommendation + harness, 2) per-route batching presets, 3) eval-triggered alerts (Signals phase). Which of these are must-have for GA? My leaning: 1+2 for GA, 3 for beta.

jordan: Agreed. Signals is high value but needs careful UX for false positives. Beta it.

lee: Roadmap weeks estimate: Core (6 wks): batching presets (2w), caching suggestions + KV telemetry (2w), quant recommendations + harness (2w). Signals (8 wks): eval pipeline, thresholding UX, webhook alert actions.

anita: Risk register quick list: quant-induced hallucination regressions; telemetry gaps; customers wanting per-model tuned profiles. Mitigation: strong canary on small percentage of traffic + explicit rollback.

sam: Action items:
- maria: finalize GA vs Beta decision by EOD Fri (action)
- jordan: draft MVP docs + example configs (3d)
- lee: open telemetry ticket for seq-length + prefix heuristics (today)
- anita: write launch criteria checklist (SLOs, econ delta, eval harness) (2d)

maria: I'll ping legal if there are any compliance implications for adding telemetry. Also will sync with Customer Success about pilot customers (Acme/Stripe) for early validation.

ops-bot: noted action items, created task OPT-452 in triage board.

sam: If we get buy-in, propose a small pilot: deploy to 3 customers with different traffic shapes (chatty, short Q&A, high-token single-turn). Collect metrics for 2 weeks.

jordan: Pilot acceptance criteria: non-negative user-facing errors, econ delta >=10% for at least 2 pilots, no regression >3% on concordance on critical evals.

maria: Great. Let's reconvene next Tue 11am to review pilot plan & owner assignments. :calendar:

lee: +1, I'll slot telemetry ETA by EOD.

anita: adding doc references in the thread in the morning.

maria: Thanks all — moving to finalize scope.
